hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Observe that total sum strictly increases with dimension size n, enabling monotonic search.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: Decompose the 3D cell sum formula into the product of sum of i from 0 to n-1 and the double summation of (j or k) from 0 to n-1.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: Precompute the double bitwise or prefix table incrementally and use binary search to locate the maximal valid dimension size.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Evaluates in optimal O(MX^2 + log(MX)) runtime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force exhaustive search exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(MX) auxiliary memory for optimal state tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies optimal pattern to achieve O(MX^2 + log(MX)) complexity.
